title: Reverted Eggs
description: Reverts Spawn Eggs to the pre 1.21.5 Spawn Egg format and texture
body:
This resource pack takes the formatting and textures of Spawn Eggs from versions before 1.21.5 and brings them back, including new colorings for Spawn Eggs that never had a variant in this format.

I put this together since I personally dislike the new Spawn Egg textures in later versions, and thought to make it public for all. :)
